entry.title: SEQUENCE vs IDENTITY in SQL Server: Choosing the Right Auto-Increment
entry.summary: TL;DR Pick the wrong auto-increment strategy in SQL Server and you find out in production. An INT IDENTITY column hits 2,147,483,647. Replication nodes collide on the same keys. A failover jumps the counter by 10,000. IDENTITY for simple single-table surrogate keys. SEQUENCE for anything that crosses tables, needs pre-allocation, or has to survive a migration. Neither gives you gapless numbering.
